summary.text: Woody Page (Woodman Page) is a Republican state representative from Orleans-2 who has served in the Vermont House of Representatives since January 2019 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Woody Page assumed office in the Vermont House on January 9, 2019, succeeding Gary Viens.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignment from 2019 through 2024 as the Health Care Committee.
